lint.//shape: Matches the template's app-tauri:lint exactly — config/ only, not commands/ (that dir stays eslint-ignored, see eslint.config.ts). Needed packages/app/tauri/tsconfig.json (new — codm had none) so eslint's typed projectService can parse config/, and a matching entry in the root tsconfig.json references so the service discovers it — same prerequisite the template already had.

test.//dependsOn: WITHOUT THIS THE TARGET DIES BEFORE THE FIRST #[test]. `build.rs` calls `tauri_build::build()`, which resolves `bundle.externalBin` + `bundle.resources` from tauri.conf.json BEFORE any test compiles — the test profile exempts nothing. Since `binaries/` is gitignored (src-tauri/.gitignore:6) and only `release-*.yml` ever produced it, `cargo test` exited 101 in any clean tree: `resource path binaries/codm-daemon-<triple> doesn't exist`. The target was born RED-FROM-CLEAN in 192f8ce9 — it passed once only because that tree still held sidecars from an earlier `desktop:dev`. With `.githooks/pre-push` running `set -e`, this blocked EVERY push, and took down with it the `tests/no_raw_http.rs` rail (which forbids raw reqwest outside src/api/mod.rs) and tauri-specta's bindings.ts regeneration (desktop-shell/SKILL.md:73,:183). Mirrors `dev` and `bundle`, which already declared the same dependency. Measured 2026-08-18: sidecar build 2.09s, 64 tests green in 0.90s — so the dependency is cheap even though `sidecars` is uncached.
test.//shape: The template splits this in two — `test` runs `bun test config/` and a SEPARATE `test:rust` runs cargo — because its hot path is bun-only ON PURPOSE (a contributor with neither Go nor Rust must keep `bun run test` green). The codm does NOT inherit that restriction, and it is measured, not assumed: `client:test` is already `cargo test --manifest-path dist/rust/Cargo.toml` and `@codm/contracts:test` already ends in `bun run test:rust && bun run test:go`, so `nx run-many -t test` here has been invoking cargo and go all along. Splitting would put this crate in a lane nothing runs — which is exactly the state this target exists to end. The bun side of the config/ tests is not duplicated here: it already belongs to `test:tooling` (./packages/app/tauri/config).
